gutter.$description: Page side padding. Tier (stepped, not fluid): it changes at the same breakpoints as the grid so margins and columns stay aligned

grid-gap.$description: Gap between grid cells. Tier: moves with the gutter and the column count

header-height.$description: Use as min-height: the header content decides the final height. Tier: 64px, 80px once the inline navigation appears (the Design System's shipped behavior)

drawer-width.$description: Width of a cart / menu / filter drawer, set on a panel anchored to the viewport edge. Tier: below 600px it is a full-width sheet (a 26rem cap alone is already full width up to 416px but leaves a 1 to 44px sliver of page between 417 and 460px, 12px at 430px, and a fixed 44px peek strip is an undiscoverable dismiss target); from 600px a 26rem side panel (416px, always leaving page visible). The sheet needs a visible close button, a scrolling body and a visible primary action (all present in the dashboard specimen); Escape, focus trap and focus return are JavaScript, not yet built

products.$description: Collection / search product grid. Tier: 2 columns on phones give a card 136px wide at 320px, 156px at 360px and 171px at 390px (16px gutter and gap); 3 and 4 follow as width allows. Other page grids are decided in the wireframe phase

portrait.$description: The 4:5 product canvas: the provisional default for product-card images only (not validated: no real photography has been supplied). The PDP gallery follows it by default through its own token; hero, editorial, collection tiles and banners use the other ratios
